name: Golden Coil
description: A tight coiled spiral in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

code.style: --rule: ( background-color: var(--color0); background-image: @doodle( background-size: 125px 125px; background-image: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 3 / 100%; transform: scale(calc(3 / 2)); } z-index: @ri(100); :after, :before { content: ''; @size: 100%; border-radius: 50%; position: absolute; background: radial-gradient( @stripe.@m8.@pn(var(--color1), var(--color2)) ); } :before { transform: translate(50%, 50%); } ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
